t: This machine can extract enchantments from items when provided with a book. $(br2)It can function 2 ways, extract the enchantments into a book or it can extract the enchantment and transform it into $(l:agr_husb/essence)Essence$().
该机器可在提供书本的前提下，从物品中提取附魔。$(br2)其具备两种运行模式：将附魔提取至书本中，或将附魔转化为$(l:agr_husb/essence)精华$()。
